header.title: Join the <highlight>Closed Beta</highlight>
header.lead: Nitro Racer, our first racing game, is on the Google Play Closed Testing track. Help us tune its handling, championships and garage before launch. Arena Legends, our last beta, is now live on Google Play.
header.joinGroupNote: Join with the Google account on your Android phone, then opt in on Google Play and install. Sign up below too so we can keep you posted.

earlyBuilds.title: Exclusive Early Builds

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about participating in the SouMoster closed beta program

howWorks.q: How does Google Play Closed Testing work?
howWorks.a: Google Play requires developer accounts to invite trusted testers through specific closed testing tracks. Once we add your Google Play email, Google generates a private testing link allowing you to install the test build through the official Play Store app.

isFree.q: Is testing free? Are there in-app purchases during the beta?
isFree.a: Yes, testing is 100% free. Any in-app purchases enabled during testing use Google Play Test Billing (sandbox mode), which does not charge real currency.

android.a: Arena Legends and Road Hopper support Android 7.0 (API 24) and newer. Nitro Racer, Time Hopper and Bank Hopper support Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer. Space Hopper and Lantern Depths are still in development.

isOpen.q: Is Nitro Racer Closed Testing open now?
isOpen.a: Yes. Nitro Racer is on the Google Play Closed Testing track. Join our tester Google Group with the Google account on your phone, then opt in and install from the Play Store listing. Arena Legends has finished testing and is now live on Google Play.

trailers.q: Where can I watch gameplay and trailers?

feedback.q: How do I submit bug reports and gameplay feedback?
feedback.a: You can send feedback directly through the Google Play Store private feedback form, visit our <support>Support Page</support>, or email us at <mail>soumoster@gmail.com</mail>.
